resorts.name: Niseko Grand Hirafu
resorts.name_ja: ニセコグラン・ヒラフ
resorts.notes: Largest of the four Niseko United resorts; busiest base village with most lodging, restaurants and nightlife.

resorts.name: Niseko Hanazono Resort
resorts.notes: Connected to Hirafu via lifts and Niseko United pass. Wide groomers, family terrain park, premium gondola, and Park Hyatt at the base.

resorts.name: Niseko Village
resorts.notes: Self-contained ski-in/ski-out village with Hilton, Green Leaf and Kasara properties at the base of the gondola.

resorts.name: Niseko Annupuri International
resorts.name_ja: ニセコアンヌプリ国際スキー場
resorts.notes: Quietest of the four, wide and forgiving runs, good for families and intermediates. Connects to Niseko Village mid-mountain.

resorts.name: Niseko Moiwa Ski Resort
resorts.name_ja: ニセコモイワスキーリゾート
resorts.notes: Not part of the Niseko United pass; separate ticket. Small, quiet, locals' favorite with excellent tree skiing on powder days.

lift_passes.name: Niseko United All-Mountain Pass
lift_passes.notes: Indicative 2024/25 walk-up rates; online and multi-day passes are cheaper. Verify before purchase.
